messages:
sophia: kicking off bring-up for model v2.5-int4 (longdoc focused). noticed a subtle drift on long-tail docs after quant. small but consistent.

mike: can you paste the AB slices? curious which cohorts show drift — seqlen, code, qa?

sophia: mostly seqlen>2k and code snippets. summary numbers: PPL +2.1%, Rouge-L -0.6 on longctx slice. shortform is fine.

ada: do we have rollout_gates config for the canary? want to ensure hysteresis so we don't thrash.

sophia: yes, initial canary is 2% traffic, 1h ramp, guard rails: soft_thresholds and hard_thresholds. soft triggers a hold and extended observation, hard triggers autofallback.

lukas: propose we add a heatmap-based slice gating: weight recent deltas by slice volume and recency, then compute a composite score. if composite > 0.8 -> hard fallback. if 0.5-0.8 -> soft hold.

mike: sounds good. also add cooldown windows to avoid oscillation (min 30m between unfallback/retry).

ada: agreed. sketch of config i'm going to push to the canary controller:

```
{"rollout": "v2.5-int4",
 "phases": [{"pct":2, "duration":"1h"},{"pct":10,"duration":"2h"}],
 "gates": {
   "soft": {"composite_score": 0.5, "action":"pause_ramp","inspect_window":"60m"},
   "hard": {"composite_score": 0.8, "action":"autofallback","cooldown":"30m"}
 }
}
```

sophia: perfect. also including a per-slice minimum sample threshold (n>=200) so small slices don't dominate.

lukas: can we surface a tiny heatmap in the console for quick ops triage? red cells show slices that pushed composite over soft/hard.

infra-bot: deploy triggered by ada — canary config push to canary-controller v1.14. Logs: /ops/deploys/1743216795

deploy-bot: rollout started: v2.5-int4 -> 2% (canary-controller). monitoring: concordance, mrr_longdoc, latency_p95.

mike: reminder: include an automatic shadow compare job (quiet burn) for 10% of traffic routed to shadow. we want signal redundancy.

sophia: already on it. shadow job scheduled and will run evals every 15m for first 3h. will post slice heatmaps to thread.

ada: finalize: soft=hold+notify to eng-ml, hard=autofallback + annotated incident. cooldown 30m. per-slice n>=200, weight recency half-life 45m.

lukas: ll ok. if we see repeat soft holds on same slice, we should auto escalate to accuracy-owners and pin model to previous stable variant until manual clear.

sophia: agreed. i'll monitor first 2h and report back. thanks all :thumbsup:
